name: Finally Together
source:
Anna is an 18 year old cam girl. She met Emily online a few months ago, and they instantly fell in love. Their long distance relationship has grown day by day, but it was not enough...the day they have dreamt of has finally arrived.

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/finally-together.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
安娜是一名18岁的主播女孩。几个月前，她在网上遇见了艾米丽，两人立刻坠入爱河。她们的异地恋一天天加深，但这还不够……她们梦寐以求的那一天终于到来了。

（来源：[url=https://affect3dstore.com/finally-together.html]官方网站[/url]）
